metadata.description: Skills for operating Figma files and writing product specs

plugins.name: fig
plugins.description: A bundle for tidying, auditing and syncing Figma files that are already drawn. Preparation (prep), flow arrows (arrows), a read-only audit gate (lint), canonical sync (sync), applying to code (code), QA (qa), presentation decks (deck) and more — 13 in all.

plugins.name: pm
plugins.description: A bundle for writing product specs against a format and verifying them. Gather material -> recommended answers -> catch vague wording and empty definitions -> publish. Where it is stored (markdown, git, Notion) is decided by config.
